name: Horde Intervention: a Horde Supplies crate destroys once, not on every click (COA-10409)
contract: Quest 175150 needs 7 of 16 Horde Supplies crates (GO 2300709) destroyed. The crate was a pure native GOOBER with autoCloseTime and consumable both 0, so nothing stopped a single crate from being spam-clicked for the whole objective. It now carries SmartGameObjectAI with an On Use force-despawn (1 s delay, respawn per the spawn table's 60 s), mirroring the already-shipped Trogg Idol (2300633) pattern: one use credits once and removes the crate; the next life (after its own respawn) credits again.
